Class GameContext

java.lang.Object
core.GameContext
public class GameContext extends Object
Central coordinator for the entire game application. Owns all managers (score, room, upgrade, collision), the game loop, UI screens, and game state. Handles state transitions (menu, playing, upgrade, paused, game over) and screen switching.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameContext

      public GameContext(javafx.scene.Scene scene, javafx.scene.layout.StackPane root, javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas canvas, double width, double height)
      Constructs the game context and initializes all subsystems. Preloads sounds, creates UI screens, and starts the game loop.
      Parameters:
      scene - JavaFX scene
      root - root layout pane
      canvas - canvas for rendering
      width - window width
      height - window height

  • Method Details

    • showMenu

      public void showMenu()
      Transitions to the main menu screen. Switches state, shows menu UI, and plays menu music.

    • startNewRun

      public void startNewRun()
      Starts a new game run. Resets score/rooms, creates new player with starting weapon, loads first room, and fades in.

    • onRoomCleared

      public void onRoomCleared()
      Called by game loop when all enemies are defeated. Adds room bonus, checks for upgrade, and either loads next room or shows upgrade screen. If boss is next, includes heal upgrade option.

    • onGameOver

      public void onGameOver()
      Called by game loop when player dies. Transitions to game over screen and displays final stats.

    • togglePause

      public void togglePause()
      Toggles between PLAYING and PAUSED states. Shows settings screen when pausing, HUD when unpausing.

    • openSettingsFromMenu

      public void openSettingsFromMenu()
      Opens settings screen from main menu.

    • closeSettings

      public void closeSettings()
      Closes settings screen. Returns to gameplay if paused, or main menu if opened from menu.

    • quit

      public void quit()
      Exits the application.
